lessons.title: Sfumato: smoke between light and dark
lessons.intro: Sfumato is not blur. It is atmosphere — the air between the eye and the form.
lessons.outro: Practice: edge one silhouette without a hard line.

sections.title: Definition
sections.narration: Sfumato softens transitions so the eye cannot say where shadow begins.

sections.title: Observation drill
sections.narration: Look at the cheek of a portrait: find three values, not two.

lessons.title: Bone before beauty
lessons.intro: The face is architecture. Muscles follow bone; expression follows muscle.
lessons.outro: Sketch the skull under every likeness you admire.

sections.title: Planes of the head
sections.narration: Block the head as planes — forehead, cheek, jaw — before detail.

sections.title: Eye socket truth
sections.narration: The eye sits in shadow of the brow. Ignore that and the portrait floats.

lessons.title: Proportion as quiet structure
lessons.intro: Geometry is not decoration. It is the path the eye walks.
lessons.outro: Place one focal point on a harmonic division — then justify it.

sections.title: Divisions
sections.narration: Divide the rectangle once. Ask whether the subject earns that line.

sections.title: Spiral attention
sections.narration: A soft spiral of values can guide attention better than a hard arrow.

weeks.title: Light, Shadow, and the Soul of the Subject

lessons.title: Light that reveals character
lessons.intro: Light is not illumination only — it is judgment of what matters.
lessons.outro: Dim one light source. See which truth remains.

sections.title: Single source
sections.narration: One dominant light creates hierarchy. Two equal lights create noise.

sections.title: Shadow as form
sections.narration: Shadow holds volume. Flatten shadow and the soul leaves the face.
